characters.name: Ray
characters.description: The main protagonist. Action Survivor: He's never been martially trained but still manages to survive a lot of dangerous situations in which countless other people die by the hands of the aliens. Amicably Divorced: He and his ex seem on pretty good terms, despite things not working out between them. Berserk Button: Don't threaten his kids. Jerk with a Heart of Gold: At first. He has trouble relating to his kids, as when he plays catch with Robbie and reacts to his son's criticisms by throwing the ball at a window (whichdidn't help their relationship). However, despite his selfish behaviour and lack of presence in his kid's lives, it's clear that he loves his children and as the film goes on, he goes to great lengths to protect them during the invasion,including killing a man.

characters.name: Rachel
characters.description: Actual Pacifist: She finds any violence or fighting upsetting, shows no desire for revenge on the aliens, and is distressedwhen Ray is about to kill Ogilvy despite understanding why he's doing it. Admiring the Abomination: She's fascinated by the aliens while they're exploring the basement, despite obviously being scared of them. All Girls Like Ponies: She rides horses, and has won an award in a competition. All-Loving Hero: She's willing to help people she doesn't even know, innocently asking Ray if they can give a ride to a man who's attacking their car. She's also distressed whenRay is about to kill Ogilvy, despite him being a threat to her. Children Are Innocent: Her reactions are pretty accurate for a ten-year old. She often doesn't understand what's happening or why, and Ray is very intent on keeping her from seeing the more traumatic events.

characters.name: Robbie
characters.description: Big Brother Instinct: It's very apparent he cares deeply for his sister. He's able to calm her down when she's panicking when their dad can't. A very telling moment is when Robbie and Ray get into an argument about their plans and Robbie's desire to go with the military to fight, Rachel says this.Rachel: Robbie! Where are you trying to go? What are you trying to do? Who's gonna take care of me when you go? Calling Parents by Their Name: Because of his resentment towards his father, he calls him 'Ray' most of the time.He eventually does call him 'Dad' when he tries to get his attention. Leeroy Jenkins: He's determined to go off and fight the aliens, despite Ray pointing out that this won't end well. Too Dumb to Live: He runs to try and help the military out of a hotheaded desire to fight back against the alien invaders despite Ray's best efforts to stop him and even the soldiers shoving him back, and despite lacking no military training or fighting prowess. This leads to him being presumed dead when the military forces on the hill are wiped out.He shows up alive at the end, apparently completely unscathed and with no explanation as to how he survived the hillside battle much less alone on the run for the rest of the movie. Troubled Teen: Combined withTeen Rebellion. His parent's divorce and Ray's distance make him condescending and snippy with Ray, even when the latter is earnestly trying to connect, rejecting him.

characters.name: Ogilvy
characters.description: A man hiding from the aliens. Adaptational Villainy: He shares the name of Ogilvy the astronomer in the book, who isn't around for long but is portrayed as a more sympathetic and amiable character. Asshole Victim:He's selfish and antagonistic to Ray, even telling Rachelto her facethat her father might die, and keepsrecklessly putting them at risk of capture. When he goes off the deep end, he even says that he doesn't care if Rayand Rachelare killed by the aliens. It's hard not to feel relief when Ray decides to kill him. Ax-Crazy: He goes into this territory after discovering the aliens are harvesting humans.This gets him killed. Composite Character: He's a combination of two different characters from the original book, and gets the name of a third.

characters.name: The Alien Invaders
characters.description: Aliens from an unknown world. They invade Earth, killing most humans they come across using their Tripods machines and "harvesting" others to feed an ecosystem they're bringing with them. They seem to be mostly unstoppable. Adaptation Backstory Change: PerinvokedSpielberg himself, the aliens in this version aren't fromMars, assince the original book was published we have long since discovered that Mars is barren and uninhabitable (but may have supported life in its distant past). He said that these aliens come from a much farther unknown planet instead. Aliens Are Bastards: They come for a planet-wide genocide. They start off by massacring a crowd of innocent people, and keep going from there. Asshole Victim:They all die from being infected by bacteria, but it's impossible to feel sympathy for them, especially given they were on a genocidal war of conquest. Bizarre Alien Biology: They have three main limbs with three fingers on each, two little limbs with two fingers on their torso, and a head shaped like a Ceratopsian dinosaur's head crest.

characters.name: Bill Ward
characters.description: Battle Couple: Even though they're no longer together, Bill and Helen are this as they are shown to still care for each other. They successfully stop and kill several of the robot dogs whilst on the search for their missing son. Bittersweet Ending:Bill is able to help Catherine close the black hole and prevent the destruction of humanity. However, he is shot by one of the robots. We do see him in a hospital still alive with his son, Dan by his bedside hinting that he may get better and re-build this relationship. In this reality, he killed Emily to prevent the alien attack but in the process ended up in prison and losing his job and relationship with his ex-wife, who he still loves. Disappeared Dad: Could be considered one as his son cuts off contactafter Bill commits murder. What his son doesn't know is that this was an act to try and save Earth from a devastating alien attack in the future. Easily Forgiven: Not so much as easily but almost reluctantly byTom in the pre-invasion timeline. This is because Bill was forced to kill Tom's sister, Emily to stop the creation of the alien race. However, the two become close friends when Tom's girlfriend is revealed to be an alien who is harvesting Tom's blood. Good Is Not Soft: Ultimately, Bill is a good person but has to do some heinous things in order to save humanity;notably committing the murder of a 17 year old girl.

characters.name: Helen Brown
characters.description: Action Mom: Helen has no problem protecting the group. She takes on supply runs and helps guard the safe house.She's killed by one of the robots after finding Emily seemingly cornered by one. Good Parents: Helen's first concern is to find her son alive.Unfortunately, the original timeline shows he was killed by the robots in the invasion. Left for Dead: Happens to Helen's current partner in the original timeline. Outliving One's Offspring

characters.name: Emily Gresham
characters.description: Adam and Eve Plot:It's revealed that the alien race are the descendants of Emily and Sacha's child conceived in the original timeline. The plot does invert this as the humans in the original timeline try to go back to prevent this from happening. Alien Sky: Emily sees a vision of three people on another plant in the season 2 opener. Amicable Exes: Shown to still be friendly with Kariem after her first time on the alien ship caused her to be away for months in the original timeline. He's shown to have gotten a new girlfriend though he still appears to have feelings for her.She moves on to Sacha after they recognise each other from their visions and she becomes pregnant. Blessed with Suck: Probably not so much blessed but her ability to feel the alien signals means she can somewhat help the other surviving humans figure out what the aliens want. Break the Cutie: Emily is introduced as being blind from a health condition. Throughout the show, she experiences an alien invasion that devastates the world,her mother and others dying,her vision coming back intermittently,being somewhat abducted by the alien race that she unknowingly created which therefore caused the future alien attack.She's alsopoisoned by Bill to try and infect the other aliens which makes her incredibly sick.

characters.name: Sarah Gresham
characters.description: Action Mom: Sarah is shown to be quite proficient with weapons later on in the show. Bittersweet Ending:In the original timeline, Sarah is shot and killed. In the pre-invasion timeline (though we don't see her after Season 1), it's mentioned that she's alive however, Emily is dead. She does become a grandmother when Tom's girlfriend becomes pregnant. Easily Forgiven: Subverted regarding Kariem. After holding her blind daughter at gunpoint, the family bump into Kariem later in a hospital. He develops a relationship with Emily which Sarah begrudgingly accepts. She even picks up condoms for her daughter on a supply run. Good Parents: Sarah is shown to be purely concerned with keeping Tom and Emily alive. She's shown to be reluctant to help others, despite Emily urging it, just so she can keep her kids alive. She does eventually help Kariem after they find him wounded in a shop but she only does this when he holds Emily at gunpoint. Gut Punch:After doing everything she could to keep her children safe, finding her husband despite the odds and helping other survivors, Sarah is shot and killed near the end of season 1.

characters.name: Tom Gresham
characters.description: Beware the Nice Ones: He starts off the show being very timid and almost annoying but he's a nice person. However, you threaten any of his family and he will turn on you. It helps that he's later trained in how to use weapons properly. Bittersweet Ending:Original timeline Tom's mother is killed, his sister has disappeared on an alien spaceship and the world is in an apocalyptic spiral however, himself and his father are alive. Pre-invasion timeline Tom's sister is dead but his parents are alive (though we don't see them). He's also going to be a father and the aliens have been killed off. Character Development: He starts the show as timid and naive but grows to be protective and brave. Fatal Attractor: His girlfriend in season 3is an alien. Human Resources: In Season 3, the pre-invasion timeline shows Tom with his girlfriend, Martha.It turns out Martha is one of the aliens and has been drugging Tom so she can take his blood, use it in transfusions on her brother so he can be well enough to create the technology to attack Earth.

characters.name: Kariem Gat Wich Machar
characters.description: Badass Normal: Has no known military training but is great at protecting the survivors when robots or aliens attack. Beware the Nice Ones: He's shown to be kind and friendly however, he will fiercely protect those he cares about, particularly Emily. Bittersweet Ending: In the original timeline,Kariem loses the girl he loves after she leaves on an alien spacecraft.He's in the UK illegally (however, this doesn't mean much due any semblance of authority not existing) but won't see his family again but he's alive. In the pre-invasion timeline,he survives and has a burgeoning romance with Zoe. Do You Want to Copulate?: Emily asks Kariem if he wants to have sex with her which he agrees. They embark on a short romance. Easily Forgiven: After attempting to rob what he thought was an abandoned shop, Kariem is shot. Emily and her family find him but despite Emily's pleas for her mother to help Kariem, she declines. Kariem holds Emily gunpoint in desperation so they'll help him. When the family find him later in the show, not only does Emily begin a relationship with him but her family seem to forgive him.

characters.name: Jonathan Gresham
characters.description: Friends with Benefits: It's unclear what his relationship with Chloe is. They seem romantically involved at some point but when they reach England, Jonathan looks to go back to his wife, Sarah. However, Sarah is upset when he reveals he had been involved with Chloe. Good Parents: Jonathan's main goal is to get back to England to find his family, including his children Emily and Tom. Parental Subsitute: He's not Emily's biological father but treats her as his own daughter. What Happened to the Mouse?: Jonathan is not seen in season 2 or 3.

characters.name: Catherine Durand
characters.description: Action Girl: Eventually becomes this as she bravely leaves the safety of the observatory multiple times. She goes back to save Sam in Season 3 when they're taken hostage by aliens. Bad Liar: In the pre-invasion timeline, Catherine manages to find Sophia. When Sophia asks about where Catherine came from and what it was like,Catherine can't admit that in that reality, Sophia had died. She's eventually found out and tells Sophia the truth. Battle Couple: Catherine and Colonel Mokrani have a brief relationship and become this when fighting their way through the invaded observatory. Big Sister Instinct: Catherine loves her younger sister and takes on a parental role when their parents die. Her first thought upon the alien invasion is to look for her sister. Bittersweet Ending:Original timeline Catherine dies, leaving behind her lover Johannes to turn off her life support however, this meant that she could time travel to pre-invasion times and close the black hole to save Earth. This also meant she could be with her sister Sophia and her niece.

characters.name: Sophia Durand
characters.description: Action Girl: She can look after herself, especially in the later seasons. Back from the Dead:Sophia has the same visions and memories as other people in the pre-invasion timeline. It prompts her to be sectioned where she escapes, walks into a road and is killed by a truck. When her sister goes back in time to close the black hole, Sophia is alive and well in this timeline, having given birth and still in a relationship with Nathan. Battle Couple: She is one with her boyfriend, Nathan, who happens to be a soldier, fighting the aliens alongside him. Character Development: It's briefly shown that Sophia and Catherine's relationship had been strained due to her drug problems and Catherine's inability to let go. However, it's shown throughout the show that Sophia isa great parentand ditches the drugs for good. Dark and Troubled Past: Sophia & Catherine's parents die in a car crash. Catherine takes on a parental role but Sophia ultimately sprials into drug dependency.

characters.name: Colonel Mustafa Mokrani
characters.description: Chronic Hero Syndrome: Due to him being in command, he stays in the observatory until the bitter end whilst the majority of the soldiers have either abandoned the post to find their families or escaped when the outpost was attacked by aliens. Militaries Are Useless: Mokrani is leading a platoon of French soldiers trying to combat against the alien invasion. However, he comes to realise that they're fighting a losing battle due to the robots outnumbering them. Odd Couple: With Catherine during season 1. Him being the soldier and Catherine being a scientist/astronomer. This could be that it's the 'end of the world' but they show genuine care for each other, up untilMokrani's death. Token Minority: He's a French military officer of Arab descent.noteThe actor Adel Bencherif is of Tunisian descent.

characters.name: Chloe Dumont
characters.description: Always Second Best: Potentially felt like this after making it into England and Jonathan reuniting with his family. There seems to be a romantic relationship between them however, Jonathan seems to drop her as soon as his wife is back in the picture. Brother–Sister Incest:Her brother Noah is revealed to have raped her. Friends with Benefits: It's unclear what the relationship between herself and Jonathan is. It almost seems they're in a relationship but when they eventually reunite with Jonathan's family, it seems that he wants to go back to his wife. Although when Sarah finds out he's been with Chloe, she seems unhappy about it despite it being unclear that anyone's family survived the attack. Good Parents: Chloe does everything she can to keep her son, Sacha safe. She never turns her back on him, even whenSacha starts murdering people. Mum Looks Like a Sister: Chloe looks like an older sister of her son, as she gave birth to him at fifteen.

characters.name: Sacha Dumont
characters.description: Adam and Eve Plot:The alien race are descended from Sacha and Emily's child. This plot is inverted as the human race try to stop this from happening so they never have this child. Awful Truth: Sacha's parentage is this for him. Ax-Crazy:Sacha's manipulative ways only fool his mother, Chloe for so long. However, Jonathan sees through him immediately. Sacha eventually goes on to kill his father/uncle Noah, Ash and Sarah. He also becomes incredibly clingy to Emily. Child by Rape:He's the son of Chloe and Noah by rape. Crazy Jealous Guy: After seeing each other in visions, Emily and Sacha eventually meethave sex and Emily becomes pregnant.Kairem had previously been in a relationship with Emily and sees that Sacha is unstable which Sacha does not like.

characters.name: Ash Daniel
characters.description: Bittersweet Ending: In the original timeline, Ashis brutally killed by Sacha, not being able to reunite with his own family and never knowing if the babies he was looking after survived.In the pre-invasion timeline,Ash survives being shot and reunites with his girlfriend and son, determined to be a better partner and father. Book Dumb: Ash isn't the smartest character but he's incredibly brave and will fight for people he cares for. Deadpan Snarker: Has a few sarcastic moments in the show. Disappeared Dad: It's implied that Ash is this to his own son.In the pre-invasion timeline, he shows up at his girlfriend's door and pleads with her for a chance to be a good dad. Out of Focus: In the pre-invasion timeline, Ash is a slightly less prominent character. He's only really seen a few times and used as a getaway driver.

characters.name: Zoe
characters.description: Action Girl: In both timelines, Zoe is shown to be adept at using a gun and strategic planning. Bittersweet Ending: In the original timeline, we don't see what becomes of Zoe, however, we know that her parents are dead.In the pre-invasion timeline, she's helped saved the world from the alien race and is set to go on a date with Kariem. Broken Bird: Zoe has had to leave her parents behind in both timelines, one where they're most likely dead and the other she asks them to leave the country. In the pre-invasion timeline, she's shown to have just left a relationship and when she goes to her boss with everything she knows about the aliens, she's sent home to take time for her mental health. Daddy's Girl: She is shown to have a strong relationship with her dad in particular.

characters.name: Nathan
characters.description: Battle Couple: Uses his military skills to keep the survivors alive alongside his girlfriend. Undying Loyalty: He's one of the only soldiers to stay behind with the Colonel to help defend the observatory.

characters.name: Juliet
characters.description: Babies Ever After: She has a vision as she watches the impending implosion of the space station of her having the baby she never got to have, due to her taking the job as as astronaut instead. Powered by a Black Hole: Subverted as Juliet is in space to collect data surrounding the black hole floating over the Earth. Space Isolation Horror:When Juliet and Richard help close the black hole, it implodes which breaks their space station apart. This sends them into space where they float and die. Unresolved Sexual Tension: With Richard. He clearly loves her but she's not sure about reciprocating.They eventually do sleep together and she decides to stay with him when they help close the black hole, despite this meaning they'll both die.

characters.name: Richard
characters.description: Powered by a Black Hole: Subverted as Richard is in space to collect data surrounding the black hole floating over the Earth. Space Isolation Horror:When Juliet and Richard help close the black hole, it implodes which breaks their space station apart. This sends them into space where they float and die. Unresolved Sexual Tension: With Juliet. He clearly loves her but she's not sure about reciprocating.They eventually do sleep together and she decides to stay with him when they help close the black hole, despite this meaning they'll both die.

characters.name: Scout Bots
characters.description: Bio Punk: The quadrupedal cyborgs sent to Earth have an organic nervous system. Cyborg: The killer robots the aliens sent to wipe out surviving humans are revealed as having organic interiors, with some nervous system driving them. Robot Soldier: Technicallycyborgs, they're sent by the aliens to kill all surviving humans after the EMP blast wipes out most. Would Hurt a Child: The aliens' killer robots target children and adults equally.A little French girl whom Sophie finds is killed after being discovered hiding. Zerg Rush: This tactic is used by the robots to avoid being easily taken out by small arms fire and explosives.
